dedupe_keys.name: water availability and river temperature scenarios for 167 water dependent power plants in the danube basin and iberian peninsula

description: This data set gives daily river discharge and river water temperature scenarios at 167 water-dependent power plants, 57 in the Danube river basin and 110 in the Iberian Peninsula. It was published on Zenodo in December 2020 by Angelo Carlino, Matteo Giuliani, Patrizia Zamberletti, Francesca Recanati and Andrea Castelletti, within the project "US-EU integrated power and water systems modelling" funded by the European Commission research directorate, and the method is described in a linked report. There are 12 CSV files split by region, variable and scenario: a baseline for 1951-2004 and RCP 2.6 and RCP 8.5 for 2006-2100. Each row holds day, month and year followed by one column per named power plant, with daily mean temperature in degrees Celsius and daily mean streamflow in cubic metres per second. Coverage is the Danube basin and the Iberian Peninsula. Files total several hundred MB, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Plants include Paks, Kozloduy, Cernavoda and Jaslovské Bohunice on the Danube side. Caveats: plants are identified by name only, and values are modelled scenarios, not observations. Simulation uses are testing cooling water limits and curtailment of thermal and nuclear plants under drought and heat, and power-water interdependency studies. Related records: data-wecc-power-plant-water-intakes covers power plant water intakes in the western US.
